hooks.name: Autonomous Task Executor
hooks.description: Injects CI/CD safety rules at the start of every turn. NOTE: matchers are ignored for UserPromptSubmit — Kiro only evaluates matcher for PreToolUse/PostToolUse (against tool name) and PostFile* (against file path). This hook therefore fires on every prompt by design; keep the prompt short to limit token cost.

action.prompt: CI/CD SAFETY: Before any push run `node scripts/check-cicd-status.js`. If IN_PROGRESS or QUEUED — do not push; wait and do non-push work. Push only via `node scripts/safe-commit-push.js "type: description"`. Only one session may push at a time (CloudFormation parallel deploys fail).
